'''Betse Silvin''' is a serving girl at [[The Golden Stag]] inn in [[Maerone]]. She is short and slim; has dark eyes; black, curly, shoulder-length hair; and pale cheeks; she is beautiful.
==Activities==
When [[Mat]] attempts to flirt with her, she begins talking incessantly and asking lots of questions. To shut her up, Mat asks her to dance and teaches her a dance he remembers from one of his past lives. 

He asks her if "[[Daughter of the Nine Moons]]" means anything to her but it does not. Later in the evening of that same day, Betse dances with Mat some more although she still refuses to kiss him.
